name: a healthy schema reports no issues
description: GET /api/db/schema-issues compares each selected replica with the master for its application partition and flattens every attribute, missing, or surplus difference into self-describing records (refKey, databaseName, tableName, columnName, issueKey, expected, actual, issue). Canonical application SchemaSpec comparison remains in Phorge and consumes schema-diff. A consistent node has no drift, so the answer is an empty data array — not a null, an error, or a missing field.
